title: What is left of the night

request.style: English, male baritone, solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, strings, mournful and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Someone calls out from Seir
Watchman how far has the night gone?
He answers morning is coming
But night remains on the horizon

[Chorus]
What is left of the night
If you must ask then ask
Come back again to seek
What is left of the night

[Verse]
Caravans of Dedan stop
Camp in the thickets of Arabia
People of Tema bring water
Meet the fugitives with bread

[Chorus]
What is left of the night
If you must ask then ask
Come back again to seek
What is left of the night

[Verse]
They flee from the drawn sword
From the bent bow and battle
The Lord says in one year
The splendor of Kedar ends

[Chorus]
What is left of the night
If you must ask then ask
Come back again to seek
What is left of the night

[Bridge]
The remnant of the bowmen
Warriors of Kedar will be few
The God of Israel has spoken
His word stands firm and true

[Outro]
What is left of the night
Come back again to seek
